text: Choose a response to a design gap
Practice how to decide which gap matters before improving a bid.
Check the full mandatory list before choosing an optional improvement.
Example: Your platform has high rated mobility. Its required protection is still below the minimum.

items: Buy more mobility This may raise score, but the design still fails its required protection.
Find a card that closes the protection gap This addresses the blocking requirement. Recheck other effects after purchase.
Submit now using the high score The score does not override a mandatory failure.

text: The new protection card meets that minimum but may reduce mobility. What next?

items: Add every effect and check all minimums This is the correct whole-design check after a purchase.
Ignore the mobility penalty Ignoring a negative effect makes the totals untrustworthy.

text: You recomputed the design and checked every requirement.
Compliance depends on the full design, not the newest card alone.
The proposed action did not establish full compliance.
Revisit the requirement gaps and recompute every card effect.
A clear requirement gap should guide the next design action.
